## See the UI

- `./gradlew :cmp-desktop:run` — Desktop window — fastest way to actually look at the shared UI
- `./gradlew :cmp-web:wasmJsBrowserDevelopmentRun` — Browser — shared UI in a dev server
- `xcodebuild -project iosApp/iosApp.xcodeproj -scheme <scheme> -destination "id=$(xcrun simctl list devices available -j | jq -r '..|objects|select(.name?=="iPhone 17")|.udid' | head -1)" build` — iOS simulator — drive by UDID, never by name
- `open docs/screenshots` — 69 captured screenshots — look before you build

## Wired tooling

- **detekt** — static analysis
- **ktlint** — formatting
- **Compose Multiplatform** — shared UI
- **Ktor** — HTTP

## Convention plugins in use

- `kursi.kmp.pure`
- `shared.purity`

Change one of these and every module applying it changes. That is usually the cheapest place to fix
something that appears in many modules at once.
